notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide and docs/evidence/debitcard.md at e7ed622. The guide's Sources note was checked on 28 October 2026 on the installed build itself (jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02, Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October), so items citing it carry that build. The evidence's dbe0e02 section (#363 verified 27 October on dbe0e02, published 28 October) replaces its 21 October sections (0.1.78-c7d3348) where they differ; from those older sections only facts still true on dbe0e02 are used (the default art strip, the two logo slots, the number shown as passed, the wrapping name, style). Installed DebitCard.tsx and the debitCard/* tokens still match every guide sentence used here, read from source, not run: 328 × 224 with radius 16 from single-mode tokens; header padding 16 top, 20 sides, 28 bottom, with a minimum height of 16 + 29 + 28 = 73, so the top band is 73 px with or without a 29 px logo and grows with a taller one; the art strip is 50 px tall with 4 px corners and cover fit, the bundled strip when cardArtSource is undefined, your picture otherwise, and dropped by showArt false or cardArtSource null while the card keeps its height; footer gap 16 and side padding 20; bankName and cardType sit on one line and end in an ellipsis; cardNumber is shown exactly as passed; cardholderName wraps; bankLogoSlot comes before the name (gap 4) and providerLogoSlot after the type (gap 8), both given the card's modes; DebitCard brand changes only debitCard/background (JFS #cea15a by default, SBI #5d00b5), the SBI text is white through a check on the brand mode in code, and the art doesn't change; with onPress the card is a Pressable button named by accessibilityLabel or bank, type and number, at 0.75 opacity while pressed, and disabled stops it; without onPress it is a View with role group and the same name; disabled dims to 0.5 either way. No guide sentence is contradicted. Two details the guide leaves out: the picture state is also a named group (recorded from the evidence), and disabled dims a card without onPress too (the prop's JSDoc says so; the guide speaks of a pressable card). The evidence's 21 October Contract, Discrepancies and Limits still say cardArtSource null isn't in the type, there's no pressed feedback, disabled works only with onPress, header text is clipped and a picture card has no name; the installed types and the dbe0e02 section supersede them, so they are not used. The guide removes the art with showArt false, so null appears only on the showArt evidence fact. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every card, Title and VStack) and no DebitCard brand (the guide's SBI example keeps the JioFinance copy, and no guide sentence says which content needs the SBI brand, so an example would have to invent an SBI card); the In context VStack's Slot gap M, Padding None and 328 px width are left out. The guide's bank mark is a docs asset (jio-gold-logo.png) in a 29 × 29 Coin Image; examples pass a Coin Image with a { uri } source that stands for the app's own mark, since the package ships no logos. Copy is the guide's own (JioFinance, Priya Sharma, •••• 4821, •••• 7350, 09/29, the two spoken names). Left out of examples, since the pack allows three: the playground, the SBI brand, the Long name, a disabled card and the two Don'ts; Credit is shown inside the In context example. Not recorded: Biscuit's handwritten Storybook page summarised in the evidence (use instead CcCard, CardBankAccount or Balance), because the guide doesn't say it and that page isn't published, so avoidWhen holds only the guide's flip, freeze and CVV limit; the published Storybook's stories all rendering as buttons and its older generated page (a Storybook issue, reported); the header and footer paddings beyond what the rules name; and, per the pack's rules, dark mode and screen-reader names. The #363 problems fixed and verified on dbe0e02 are not gaps. The Sources note's showArt={false} renders as “showArt=” (JSX drops {false} inside its code element), so no quote spans it.

evidenceFacts.quote: SBI text is `#ffffff` on the `#5d00b5` brand (9.85:1), also when the brand comes from JFSThemeProvider; JFS stays `#141414` on `#cea15a` (7.78:1).

gaps.text: Figma's Debit Card exposes cardholderName, cardNumber and expireDate as properties; its bank and network logos are nested instances and its brand is a variable mode. In code bankName and cardType are props, and the logos go in bankLogoSlot and providerLogoSlot.
